description: This file implements deep link handling in a macOS application, including validation, delivery logic, and user prompts. It defines policy enums, a singleton handler class, and related functions for processing URL-based commands, specifically for agent actions within the OpenClaw app.

classes.name: DeepLinkHandler
classes.description: A singleton class managing deep link processing, validations, UI prompts, and communication with backend services for agent invocation within a macOS application.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a URL to determine and handle deep link routes, including validation and user prompts.

methods.name: handleAgent
methods.description: Handles agent-specific deep links by validating message size, prompting user confirmation if needed, and sending agent requests.

methods.name: currentKey
methods.description: Returns the current session key used for deep link authentication.

methods.name: currentCanvasKey
methods.description: Returns the ephemeral key used for Canvas-originated unattended deep links.

methods.name: expectedKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a persistent session key stored in user defaults.

methods.name: generateRandomKey
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random string key.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to the user and returns whether they approved.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays an informational alert with a message.
